title: Tech Investors Look to Space for Data Centers
excerpt: Following recent Democratic victories in Texas and other AI infrastructure hubs, data center developers are exploring options in low Earth orbit.
body_html:
Following major Democratic victories in Texas and other key artificial intelligence infrastructure regions on Tuesday, supporters of data centers are turning their attention toward low Earth orbit.

As political shifts impact traditional infrastructure hotspots on the ground, interest in placing data centers in space has emerged among industry enthusiasts seeking alternative locations for their operations.
